title: Clementin's birth, trade and homes
summary: Clementin gives his birth year (1894), says he was a bricklayer and discusses how long they have lived in the house and where they lived before.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I don't even know what you said.

Well, first of all, when were you born in the Claremont? 1894. 2587. And what was your job? Did you have any trade? I was in bricklayer work. How long have you been living in this house? About 55 years. In this house, yes. More than that. No, no, we lived in another house.

I see. You see that a little house here? We was moving out to Pooncee. Then we had some Italian used to live here. I see. Then we moved here when the Italian gave up the place. So we moved here. I see. What is this, 3,300?
